description: Source file for RPC utilities in PyTorch's distributed RPC module, including functions for serialization/deserialization, error handling, and processing profiling events.

methods.name: processRemoteProfiledEvents
methods.description: Processes and attaches remote profiling events to the local profiler, ensuring correct profiling across threads.

methods.name: getRPCErrorType
methods.description: Parses a JitFuture error message to determine the specific RPC error type.

methods.name: makeRPCError
methods.description: Constructs a formatted RPC error string with error type and message.

methods.name: deserializeRequest
methods.description: Deserializes a Message into the appropriate RPC request object based on message type.

methods.name: deserializeResponse
methods.description: Deserializes a Message into the appropriate RPC response object and handles special cases like autograd responses.

methods.name: deserializeRespToIValue
methods.description: Converts a response Message into an IValue by deserializing the response.

methods.name: parseWireSections
methods.description: Parses wire format data into sections for payload, metadata, and tensors.

methods.name: cloneSparseTensors
methods.description: Clones tensors if beneficial for wire transfer, especially small views.

methods.name: wireSerialize
methods.description: Serializes payload and tensors into a wire format with headers.

methods.name: wireDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes wire format data into payload and tensors.

methods.name: writeWrappedPayload
methods.description: Appends additional payload to the original payload with size prefix.

methods.name: readWrappedPayload
methods.description: Extracts and unpacks wrapped payload and tensors from combined data.

methods.name: populateRemoteProfiledEvents
methods.description: Aggregates profiling events and adjusts CUDA event timings for remote profiling.
